hypothesis.en: The researchers designed a simple test to check their hypothesis about bird migration.
hypothesis.zh: 研究者设计了一项简单的测试,来检验他们关于鸟类迁徙的假设。

theory.en: According to one theory, the stone circle was used to track the seasons.
theory.zh: 有一种理论认为,这个石圈曾被用来追踪季节变化。

assumption.en: The model rests on the assumption that prices will remain stable.
assumption.zh: 这个模型基于一个假定:价格将保持稳定。

premise.en: The theory rests on the premise that all languages share a basic structure.
premise.zh: 这一理论有一个前提:所有语言都有相同的基本结构。

evidence.en: There is little evidence that the new teaching method improves exam results.
evidence.zh: 几乎没有证据表明新教学方法能提高考试成绩。

proof.en: So far, scientists have found no proof of life on other planets.
proof.zh: 到目前为止,科学家还没有找到其他星球存在生命的证明。

argument.en: The main argument of the article is that cities need more green space.
argument.zh: 这篇文章的主要论点是城市需要更多绿地。

argument.en: The plan led to a long argument among members of the committee.
argument.zh: 这项计划在委员会成员中引发了长时间的争论。

claim.en: The company's claim that its product saves energy has been questioned.
claim.zh: 该公司声称产品节能,这一说法受到了质疑。

claim.en: Some historians claim that the tower was built much earlier than records show.
claim.zh: 一些历史学家声称,这座塔的建造时间比记载的要早得多。

assert.en: The author asserts that early education shapes a child's later success.
assert.zh: 作者断言,早期教育影响孩子日后的成功。

contend.en: Some economists contend that higher taxes would slow the growth of small businesses.
contend.zh: 一些经济学家主张,提高税收会减缓小企业的发展。

contend.en: Young trees must contend with larger plants for light and water.
contend.zh: 小树必须与较大的植物争夺阳光和水分。

maintain.en: Critics maintain that the study was too small to be reliable.
maintain.zh: 批评者坚持认为,这项研究规模太小,不可靠。

maintain.en: Sleep helps the brain to maintain its ability to store new information.
maintain.zh: 睡眠有助于大脑维持储存新信息的能力。

propose.en: The author proposes a new way of measuring happiness across different countries.
propose.zh: 作者提出了一种衡量不同国家幸福感的新方法。

suggest.en: Recent findings suggest that bees can recognise individual human faces.
suggest.zh: 最新发现表明,蜜蜂能够识别人类的面孔。

suggest.en: The report suggests building more cycle paths to reduce traffic in the city.
suggest.zh: 报告建议修建更多自行车道,以减少城市交通流量。

imply.en: The results imply that diet may play a larger role than exercise.
imply.zh: 结果暗示,饮食的作用可能比运动更大。

infer.en: From the tools they left behind, we can infer how these people lived.
infer.zh: 从他们留下的工具中,我们可以推断出这些人的生活方式。

deduce.en: Scientists can deduce the age of a tree by counting its rings.
deduce.zh: 科学家可以通过数年轮推算出树的年龄。

conclude.en: The authors conclude that noise has a clear effect on concentration.
conclude.zh: 作者得出结论:噪音对注意力有明显影响。

verify.en: Other laboratories must verify these results before they can be accepted.
verify.zh: 这些结果必须经其他实验室核实后才能被接受。

validate.en: Further studies are needed to validate the findings of this small experiment.
validate.zh: 需要进一步研究来证实这个小型实验的结果。

refute.en: New data from the deep ocean appears to refute the earlier theory.
refute.zh: 来自深海的新数据似乎驳斥了早先的理论。

dispute.en: There is an ongoing dispute among scholars over who wrote the text.
dispute.zh: 学者们对这篇文本的作者一直存在争论。

dispute.en: Few experts now dispute the link between smoking and heart disease.
dispute.zh: 现在很少有专家质疑吸烟与心脏病之间的联系。

challenge.en: These discoveries challenge the traditional view of how farming began.
challenge.zh: 这些发现质疑了关于农业起源的传统观点。

challenge.en: Feeding a growing population is a major challenge for many developing countries.
challenge.zh: 养活不断增长的人口是许多发展中国家面临的重大挑战。

contradict.en: The second survey seems to contradict the results of the first one.
contradict.zh: 第二次调查似乎与第一次的结果相矛盾。

controversial.en: The use of animals in medical research remains a controversial issue.
controversial.zh: 在医学研究中使用动物仍然是一个有争议的问题。

consensus.en: There is now a broad consensus among scientists that the climate is warming.
consensus.zh: 现在科学家普遍达成共识:气候正在变暖。

perspective.en: The book looks at the Industrial Revolution from the perspective of ordinary workers.
perspective.zh: 这本书从普通工人的视角审视工业革命。

notion.en: The notion that intelligence is fixed at birth is no longer widely accepted.
notion.zh: 智力天生固定这一观念已不再被广泛接受。

concept.en: The concept of time differs greatly from one culture to another.
concept.zh: 时间的概念在不同文化之间差异很大。

framework.en: The study provides a useful framework for understanding how children learn languages.
framework.zh: 这项研究为理解儿童如何学习语言提供了一个有用的框架。

paradigm.en: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in the way scientists viewed disease.
paradigm.zh: 这一发现使科学家看待疾病的范式发生了转变。

principle.en: The experiment is based on a simple principle of physics.
principle.zh: 这个实验基于一条简单的物理学原理。

principle.en: Fairness is a basic principle of any good legal system.
principle.zh: 公平是任何良好法律体系的基本原则。

criterion.en: Cost should not be the only criterion for choosing a treatment.
criterion.zh: 成本不应是选择治疗方案的唯一标准。

parameter.en: The computer model allows researchers to change each parameter in turn.
parameter.zh: 这个计算机模型让研究者可以依次改变每个参数。

variable.en: Age was the most important variable in predicting how people responded.
variable.zh: 年龄是预测人们反应的最重要变量。

variable.en: Rainfall in this region is highly variable from one year to the next.
variable.zh: 该地区的降雨量每年变化很大。

factor.en: Income is an important factor in deciding where families choose to live.
factor.zh: 收入是决定家庭选择居住地的重要因素。

element.en: Trust is a key element of any successful business relationship.
element.zh: 信任是任何成功商业关系的关键要素。

element.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element and the most common in the universe.
element.zh: 氢是最轻的元素,也是宇宙中最常见的元素。

component.en: Sleep is an essential component of a healthy lifestyle.
component.zh: 睡眠是健康生活方式的重要组成部分。

aspect.en: The study focuses on one aspect of memory that is often overlooked.
aspect.zh: 这项研究聚焦于记忆中常被忽视的一个方面。

dimension.en: Music adds an emotional dimension that a written text cannot provide.
dimension.zh: 音乐增添了文字无法提供的情感维度。

scope.en: The scope of the study was limited to schools in rural areas.
scope.zh: 这项研究的范围仅限于农村地区的学校。

context.en: Words can have very different meanings depending on the context.
context.zh: 根据语境不同,词语的含义可能大不相同。

phenomenon.en: Scientists still cannot fully explain this unusual weather phenomenon.
phenomenon.zh: 科学家仍然无法完全解释这种不寻常的天气现象。

mechanism.en: Sweating is the body's main mechanism for controlling its temperature.
mechanism.zh: 出汗是人体调节体温的主要机制。

process.en: Learning a language is a slow process that requires regular practice.
process.zh: 学习语言是一个缓慢的过程,需要经常练习。

process.en: The brain can process images far more quickly than written words.
process.zh: 大脑处理图像的速度远远快于处理文字。

procedure.en: The researchers followed the same procedure for every participant in the study.
procedure.zh: 研究者对每位参与者都采用了相同的程序。

approach.en: This approach to teaching encourages students to solve problems on their own.
approach.zh: 这种教学方法鼓励学生自己解决问题。

approach.en: As birds approach the end of their journey, they begin to fly lower.
approach.zh: 鸟类接近旅程终点时,会开始飞得更低。

strategy.en: Hiding in tall grass is a common survival strategy among young deer.
strategy.zh: 躲在高草丛中是幼鹿常见的生存策略。

technique.en: Farmers developed a new technique for storing water during the dry season.
technique.zh: 农民发展出一种在旱季储水的新技术。

method.en: This method of dating ancient objects is accurate but very expensive.
method.zh: 这种测定古物年代的方法准确但非常昂贵。

investigate.en: The team set out to investigate why the fish had disappeared from the lake.
investigate.zh: 研究团队着手调查湖中的鱼为什么消失了。

examine.en: This chapter will examine the causes of the economic crisis.
examine.zh: 本章将审视这场经济危机的成因。

explore.en: Researchers are now exploring ways of turning waste into fuel.
explore.zh: 研究者正在探索把废弃物转化为燃料的方法。

analyse.en: Scientists analysed samples of ice to learn about the climate of the past.
analyse.zh: 科学家分析了冰样,以了解过去的气候。

assess.en: It is difficult to assess the long-term effects of the new policy.
assess.zh: 很难评估这项新政策的长期影响。

evaluate.en: The study set out to evaluate three different methods of teaching reading.
evaluate.zh: 这项研究旨在评价三种不同的阅读教学方法。

measure.en: The device can measure small changes in the temperature of the water.
measure.zh: 这种设备能测量水温的微小变化。

measure.en: The government has introduced measures to reduce air pollution in large cities.
measure.zh: 政府已出台措施,减少大城市的空气污染。

quantify.en: It is hard to quantify the benefits of spending time in nature.
quantify.zh: 亲近自然的益处很难量化。

identify.en: The test helps doctors to identify the disease at an early stage.
identify.zh: 这项检测帮助医生在早期发现这种疾病。

classify.en: Biologists classify animals according to their shared physical features.
classify.zh: 生物学家根据共同的身体特征对动物进行分类。

categorise.en: The researchers categorised the responses as either positive or negative.
categorise.zh: 研究者把这些回答归为正面或负面两类。

define.en: It is surprisingly difficult to define exactly what intelligence means.
define.zh: 要准确定义智力的含义,出乎意料地困难。

interpret.en: Historians interpret the meaning of these ancient paintings in different ways.
interpret.zh: 历史学家对这些古代绘画的含义有不同的解读。

illustrate.en: The story of the island illustrates how quickly a species can disappear.
illustrate.zh: 这座岛的故事说明了一个物种消失得有多快。

demonstrate.en: The experiment demonstrated that plants can respond to sound.
demonstrate.zh: 这项实验证明了植物能够对声音作出反应。

indicate.en: These figures indicate that fewer young people are moving to rural areas.
indicate.zh: 这些数字表明,搬到农村的年轻人减少了。

reveal.en: Satellite images revealed a network of ancient roads beneath the forest.
reveal.zh: 卫星图像揭示了森林下面的古代道路网。

highlight.en: The report highlights the need for more investment in public transport.
highlight.zh: 这份报告强调了增加公共交通投资的必要性。

highlight.en: The highlight of the exhibition is a collection of early maps.
highlight.zh: 这次展览最精彩的部分是一批早期地图。

emphasise.en: The author emphasises the importance of sleep for memory.
emphasise.zh: 作者强调了睡眠对记忆的重要性。

underline.en: The latest figures underline the seriousness of the water shortage.
underline.zh: 最新数据凸显了水资源短缺的严重性。

cite.en: Many studies cite this early work as the starting point of the field.
cite.zh: 许多研究引用这项早期成果,把它视为该领域的起点。

quote.en: The article quotes a scientist who worked on the original project.
quote.zh: 这篇文章引用了一位参与原项目的科学家的话。

refer-to.en: The term 'biodiversity' is used to refer to the variety of life on Earth.
refer-to.zh: “生物多样性”一词指的是地球上生命的多样性。

attribute.en: Some experts attribute the fall in crime to better street lighting.
attribute.zh: 一些专家把犯罪率下降归因于街道照明的改善。

attribute.en: Patience is an important attribute for anyone working with young children.
attribute.zh: 耐心是与幼儿打交道的人应具备的重要特质。

correlate.en: Levels of education tend to correlate with income in later life.
correlate.zh: 教育水平往往与日后的收入相关联。

correlation.en: The study found a strong correlation between exercise and improved mood.
correlation.zh: 研究发现,锻炼与情绪改善之间有很强的相关性。

replicate.en: Other researchers were unable to replicate the results of the original study.
replicate.zh: 其他研究者未能重现最初那项研究的结果。

simulate.en: Computers can simulate how a building would behave in an earthquake.
simulate.zh: 计算机可以模拟建筑物在地震中的表现。

predict.en: It is still impossible to predict exactly when an earthquake will occur.
predict.zh: 目前仍然无法准确预测地震发生的时间。

forecast.en: Long-range forecasts of the weather are often less accurate than short ones.
forecast.zh: 长期天气预报的准确度往往低于短期预报。

forecast.en: Experts forecast that demand for clean energy will continue to rise.
forecast.zh: 专家预测,对清洁能源的需求将持续上升。

estimate.en: Current estimates put the number of species in the forest at over ten thousand.
estimate.zh: 目前估计,这片森林中的物种超过一万种。

estimate.en: Researchers estimate that the cave was first used around ten thousand years ago.
estimate.zh: 研究者估计,这个洞穴大约一万年前开始被使用。

approximate.en: The map shows the approximate location of the ancient settlement.
approximate.zh: 地图标出了这处古代聚落的大致位置。

precise.en: Modern clocks allow scientists to make extremely precise measurements of time.
precise.zh: 现代时钟让科学家能够极其精确地测量时间。

accurate.en: The instrument gives a more accurate reading than older equipment.
accurate.zh: 这种仪器的读数比旧设备更准确。

reliable.en: Self-reported data on diet is not always reliable, as people forget details.
reliable.zh: 人们自述的饮食数据并不总是可靠,因为他们会忘记细节。

valid.en: The results are only valid if the sample represents the whole population.
valid.zh: 只有样本能代表总体,结果才有效。

empirical.en: There is little empirical evidence to support this popular belief.
empirical.zh: 几乎没有实证证据支持这种流行的看法。

theoretical.en: The idea remains theoretical, as no one has yet tested it in practice.
theoretical.zh: 这个想法仍停留在理论层面,因为还没有人在实践中验证过。

systematic.en: The team carried out a systematic review of all the earlier studies.
systematic.zh: 研究团队对此前所有研究进行了系统性回顾。

rigorous.en: All new medicines must pass rigorous tests before they can be sold.
rigorous.zh: 所有新药上市前都必须通过严格的测试。

subjective.en: Judgements about the quality of art are inevitably subjective.
subjective.zh: 对艺术品质量的判断难免是主观的。

bias.en: Researchers must be careful to avoid bias when they select participants.
bias.zh: 研究者在挑选参与者时必须小心避免偏差。

anomaly.en: One unusually warm year may be an anomaly rather than part of a trend.
anomaly.zh: 某一年异常温暖可能只是个例外情况,而不代表某种趋势。

exception.en: Most birds build nests, but there are some notable exceptions to this rule.
exception.zh: 大多数鸟都筑巢,但也有一些明显的例外。

limitation.en: One limitation of the study is that all the participants were university students.
limitation.zh: 这项研究的一个局限是所有参与者都是大学生。

flaw.en: A serious flaw in the design caused the bridge to shake in strong winds.
flaw.zh: 设计上的严重缺陷导致这座桥在强风中摇晃。

drawback.en: The main drawback of solar power is that it depends on the weather.
drawback.zh: 太阳能的主要缺点是依赖天气。

merit.en: Each of these approaches has its own merit, depending on the situation.
merit.zh: 根据情况不同,这些方法各有优点。

implication.en: The findings have important implications for how we treat young patients.
implication.zh: 这些发现对我们如何治疗年轻患者有重要影响。

significance.en: Few people understood the significance of the discovery at the time.
significance.zh: 当时很少有人理解这一发现的重要性。

relevance.en: Critics have questioned the relevance of these old laws to modern life.
relevance.zh: 批评者质疑这些旧法律与现代生活的相关性。

insight.en: The letters give us a valuable insight into daily life in the eighteenth century.
insight.zh: 这些信件让我们得以深入了解十八世纪的日常生活。

scrutiny.en: The company's safety record has come under close scrutiny since the accident.
scrutiny.zh: 事故发生后,该公司的安全记录受到了严格审查。

inference.en: The researchers drew an inference about diet from the marks on the teeth.
inference.zh: 研究者根据牙齿上的痕迹对饮食作出了推断。

induction.en: Induction involves forming a general rule from a number of specific examples.
induction.zh: 归纳是指从若干具体例子中得出一般规律。

induction.en: All new employees attend a one-week induction before starting work.
induction.zh: 所有新员工在开始工作前都要参加为期一周的入职培训。

deduction.en: By careful deduction, the scientist worked out where the signal came from.
deduction.zh: 通过仔细推论,这位科学家确定了信号的来源。

homogeneous.en: The sample was fairly homogeneous, with most participants coming from one city.
homogeneous.zh: 样本相当同质,大多数参与者来自同一座城市。

discrete.en: The process can be divided into four discrete stages.
discrete.zh: 这个过程可以分为四个独立的阶段。

variant.en: A new variant of the virus spread rapidly across the region.
variant.zh: 这种病毒的一种新变体在该地区迅速传播。

existence.en: The existence of water on Mars was confirmed by a recent mission.
existence.zh: 最近的一次探测任务证实了火星上存在水。

logical.en: Reducing car use seems a logical step towards cleaner air.
logical.zh: 减少用车似乎是改善空气质量的合理一步。

clue.en: The shape of the bones provides a clue to how the animal moved.
clue.zh: 骨骼的形状为了解这种动物的运动方式提供了线索。

stance.en: Scientists have taken a more cautious stance on the use of the new drug.
stance.zh: 科学家对使用这种新药采取了更谨慎的立场。

preliminary.en: Preliminary results suggest that the treatment may be effective in most patients.
preliminary.zh: 初步结果表明,这种疗法可能对大多数患者有效。

accuracy.en: The accuracy of weather forecasts has improved greatly over the last thirty years.
accuracy.zh: 过去三十年,天气预报的准确性大大提高。

reliability.en: Doubts have been raised about the reliability of data collected by telephone.
reliability.zh: 电话收集的数据的可靠性受到了质疑。

presume.en: Without written records, we can only presume that the building had a religious purpose.
presume.zh: 由于没有文字记录,我们只能推测这座建筑有宗教用途。

critique.en: Her latest book offers a sharp critique of modern consumer society.
critique.zh: 她的新书对现代消费社会提出了尖锐的评论。

analogy.en: The author uses the analogy of a computer to explain how memory works.
analogy.zh: 作者用计算机作类比来解释记忆的运作方式。

gauge.en: Surveys are used to gauge public opinion on major social issues.
gauge.zh: 调查被用来判断公众对重大社会问题的看法。

plausible.en: It seems plausible that climate change forced these people to move south.
plausible.zh: 气候变化迫使这些人南迁,这种说法似乎有道理。

randomly.en: Patients were randomly assigned to one of the two treatment groups.
randomly.zh: 患者被随机分配到两个治疗组之一。

randomise.en: Researchers randomise the order of questions to prevent any pattern affecting the answers.
randomise.zh: 研究者把问题的顺序随机化,以防某种规律影响答案。

qualitative.en: The team collected qualitative data through long interviews with local farmers.
qualitative.zh: 研究团队通过与当地农民的长时间访谈收集了定性数据。

variability.en: The study found great variability in the way that children develop speech.
variability.zh: 研究发现,儿童语言发展的方式差异很大。

confound.en: Differences in diet could confound the results of the exercise study.
confound.zh: 饮食差异可能混淆这项运动研究的结果。

null.en: The null hypothesis states that the two groups show no real difference.
null.zh: 零假设认为这两组之间没有真正的差异。

logic.en: The logic of the argument is clear, but its conclusion is hard to accept.
logic.zh: 这个论点的逻辑很清楚,但结论很难接受。

certainty.en: We cannot say with certainty when the first humans reached the island.
certainty.zh: 我们无法确切地说出最早的人类何时到达这座岛。

precedent.en: The court's decision set an important precedent for future cases.
precedent.zh: 法院的这项裁决为今后的案件树立了重要先例。

scenario.en: In the worst scenario, sea levels could rise by more than one metre.
scenario.zh: 在最坏的情景下,海平面可能上升超过一米。

lifetime.en: An average person will spend about a third of their lifetime asleep.
lifetime.zh: 普通人一生中大约有三分之一的时间在睡觉。

closure.en: The closure of the mine left hundreds of local people without work.
closure.zh: 矿山关闭导致数百名当地人失业。

domain.en: Until recently, this area of research was the domain of a few specialists.
domain.zh: 直到最近,这一研究领域还只属于少数专家。

necessity.en: The drought made careful use of water an absolute necessity for farmers.
necessity.zh: 干旱使节约用水成为农民的绝对必要之事。

essence.en: The essence of the theory can be explained in just a few words.
essence.zh: 这个理论的精髓用几句话就能解释清楚。

array.en: The rainforest contains a remarkable array of plants and animals.
array.zh: 雨林中有种类惊人的动植物。

hierarchy.en: Wolves live in groups with a strict social hierarchy.
hierarchy.zh: 狼生活在群体中,有严格的社会等级制度。

flexibility.en: Working from home gives employees greater flexibility in organising their time.
flexibility.zh: 在家办公让员工在安排时间上更加灵活。

duration.en: The duration of the treatment depends on how serious the illness is.
duration.zh: 治疗的持续时间取决于病情的严重程度。

availability.en: The availability of cheap food has changed the way people eat.
availability.zh: 廉价食品容易买到,这改变了人们的饮食方式。

realm.en: Such ideas were once considered to belong to the realm of science fiction.
realm.zh: 这样的想法曾被认为属于科幻小说的领域。

breakdown.en: A breakdown in communication between the two teams caused the project to fail.
breakdown.zh: 两个团队之间的沟通崩溃导致项目失败。

breakdown.en: The table gives a breakdown of the costs by country.
breakdown.zh: 这张表按国家列出了费用细目。

dilemma.en: Doctors face a dilemma when a treatment could both help and harm a patient.
dilemma.zh: 当一种疗法对患者既有益又有害时,医生就面临两难。

rejection.en: The rejection of the proposal surprised many members of the committee.
rejection.zh: 提案被否决令委员会的许多成员感到意外。

defect.en: A small defect in the lens made the early telescope less useful.
defect.zh: 镜片的一个小缺陷使这台早期望远镜不太好用。

chunk.en: Language learners often remember useful phrases as a single chunk.
chunk.zh: 语言学习者常把有用的短语作为一个语块来记忆。

likelihood.en: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of developing heart disease.
likelihood.zh: 经常锻炼可以降低患心脏病的可能性。

continuity.en: Older buildings give a town a sense of continuity with its past.
continuity.zh: 老建筑让一座城镇与过去之间有一种延续感。

fringe.en: The new settlements grew up on the fringe of the desert.
fringe.zh: 新的定居点出现在沙漠的边缘。

threshold.en: Sounds above a certain threshold can cause permanent damage to hearing.
threshold.zh: 超过一定阈值的声音会对听力造成永久损伤。

span.en: The study covers a span of more than fifty years.
span.zh: 这项研究的时间跨度超过五十年。

span.en: The bird's migration routes span several continents and thousands of kilometres.
span.zh: 这种鸟的迁徙路线横跨几个大洲,长达数千公里。

manipulation.en: The photographs showed clear signs of manipulation by computer.
manipulation.zh: 这些照片有明显的计算机操纵痕迹。

coordination.en: Playing a musical instrument requires good coordination between the hands and eyes.
coordination.zh: 演奏乐器需要手眼之间良好的协调。

pathway.en: Scientists have identified the pathway by which the virus enters the cell.
pathway.zh: 科学家已经确定了病毒进入细胞的途径。

progression.en: Regular exercise may slow the progression of the disease in older patients.
progression.zh: 经常锻炼可能减缓老年患者的病情发展。

instability.en: Political instability in the region has discouraged foreign investment.
instability.zh: 该地区的政治不稳定阻碍了外国投资。

displacement.en: The building of the dam led to the displacement of thousands of villagers.
displacement.zh: 大坝的修建导致数千名村民流离失所。

facet.en: Language is only one facet of a people's cultural identity.
facet.zh: 语言只是一个民族文化身份的一个方面。

selection.en: The selection of participants was based on age and level of education.
selection.zh: 参与者的选拔依据的是年龄和受教育程度。

theme.en: Loss and memory are the central themes of the novel.
theme.zh: 失去和记忆是这部小说的中心主题。

resolution.en: The two countries are still seeking a peaceful resolution to the conflict.
resolution.zh: 两国仍在寻求和平解决这场冲突。

resolution.en: The new telescope produces images of much higher resolution than before.
resolution.zh: 新望远镜拍出的图像分辨率比以前高得多。

boundary.en: The river forms a natural boundary between the two regions.
boundary.zh: 这条河构成了两个地区之间的天然边界。

assistance.en: Many of the poorest farmers rely on assistance from the government.
assistance.zh: 许多最贫困的农民依靠政府的帮助。

agenda.en: Climate change is now high on the political agenda in many countries.
agenda.zh: 气候变化现在在许多国家的政治议程上占据重要位置。

transition.en: The country is going through a slow transition from coal to renewable energy.
transition.zh: 这个国家正在经历从煤炭到可再生能源的缓慢转变。

approval.en: The new drug has not yet received approval from the health authorities.
approval.zh: 这种新药尚未获得卫生部门的批准。

reputation.en: The university has an excellent reputation for research in engineering.
reputation.zh: 这所大学在工程研究方面享有极高的声誉。

tendency.en: People have a natural tendency to remember bad news better than good news.
tendency.zh: 人们天生倾向于比好消息更容易记住坏消息。

awareness.en: Awareness of the dangers of too much sugar has grown in recent years.
awareness.zh: 近年来,人们对过量摄入糖分危害的意识有所增强。

possession.en: Possession of land was the main source of power in medieval society.
possession.zh: 在中世纪社会,拥有土地是权力的主要来源。

expansion.en: The rapid expansion of cities has put pressure on water supplies.
expansion.zh: 城市的快速扩张给供水带来了压力。

pace.en: The pace of technological change has increased dramatically since the 1990s.
pace.zh: 自 20 世纪 90 年代以来,技术变革的速度急剧加快。

guidance.en: Young teachers need clear guidance during their first year in the classroom.
guidance.zh: 年轻教师在教学的第一年需要明确的指导。

barrier.en: Language can be a serious barrier to finding work in a new country.
barrier.zh: 在新的国家,语言可能成为求职的严重障碍。

preference.en: Babies show a clear preference for faces over other objects.
preference.zh: 婴儿明显更喜欢看人脸,而不是其他物体。

ownership.en: Car ownership has fallen among young people in many large cities.
ownership.zh: 在许多大城市,年轻人的汽车拥有率有所下降。

enthusiasm.en: The public showed little enthusiasm for the government's new energy plan.
enthusiasm.zh: 公众对政府新的能源计划缺乏热情。

satisfaction.en: Studies show that job satisfaction depends more on respect than on pay.
satisfaction.zh: 研究表明,工作满意度更多取决于尊重,而不是薪水。

confusion.en: The similar names of the two species have caused much confusion among scientists.
confusion.zh: 这两个物种名称相似,在科学家中引起了很多混乱。

guideline.en: The new guidelines advise adults to walk for at least thirty minutes a day.
guideline.zh: 新准则建议成年人每天至少步行三十分钟。

ease.en: Thanks to the internet, information can now be shared with ease.
ease.zh: 有了互联网,现在分享信息变得轻而易举。

ease.en: Green spaces can ease stress and improve the mental health of city residents.
ease.zh: 绿地可以缓解压力,改善城市居民的心理健康。

declaration.en: The declaration of independence marked the beginning of a new nation.
declaration.zh: 独立宣言标志着一个新国家的诞生。

removal.en: The removal of trees from the hillside increased the risk of flooding.
removal.zh: 山坡上的树木被清除后,洪水风险增加了。

succession.en: The region suffered a succession of poor harvests during the 1840s.
succession.zh: 19 世纪 40 年代,该地区接连遭遇歉收。

succession.en: The king's death led to a long dispute over the succession.
succession.zh: 国王去世后,围绕继承权发生了长期争端。

compromise.en: The final plan was a compromise between the two opposing groups.
compromise.zh: 最终方案是两个对立群体之间的妥协。

compromise.en: Neither side was willing to compromise on the question of water rights.
compromise.zh: 在水权问题上,双方都不愿意妥协。

chaos.en: The sudden flood brought chaos to the transport system of the city.
chaos.zh: 突如其来的洪水使城市交通系统陷入混乱。

intent.en: The original intent of the law was to protect small farmers.
intent.zh: 这项法律的初衷是保护小农户。

sacrifice.en: Early settlers made great sacrifices to build a new life on the frontier.
sacrifice.zh: 早期定居者为在边疆建立新生活作出了巨大牺牲。

revelation.en: The revelation that the data had been changed damaged the scientist's career.
revelation.zh: 数据被篡改一事曝光后,这位科学家的事业受到了损害。

dignity.en: Good care allows elderly patients to live with dignity and independence.
dignity.zh: 良好的护理让老年患者能够有尊严、独立地生活。

predecessor.en: The new model uses far less fuel than its predecessor.
predecessor.zh: 新型号比它的前身省油得多。

frontier.en: Deep-sea exploration is one of the last frontiers of science.
frontier.zh: 深海探索是科学最后的前沿之一。

compliance.en: Inspectors visit factories regularly to check compliance with safety rules.
compliance.zh: 检查员定期走访工厂,检查是否遵守安全规定。

denial.en: The company's denial of any wrongdoing was not accepted by the court.
denial.zh: 该公司否认有任何不当行为,但法院不予采信。

contempt.en: Early critics treated the painter's new style with open contempt.
contempt.zh: 早期的评论家公开蔑视这位画家的新风格。

inability.en: An inability to sleep can seriously affect memory and concentration.
inability.zh: 无法入睡会严重影响记忆力和注意力。

disagreement.en: There is still some disagreement about how the ancient city was destroyed.
disagreement.zh: 关于这座古城如何被毁,目前仍存在一些分歧。

solidarity.en: The strike was a rare show of solidarity among workers in different industries.
solidarity.zh: 这次罢工罕见地展现了不同行业工人之间的团结。

clearance.en: Large-scale forest clearance has destroyed the habitat of many animals.
clearance.zh: 大规模森林砍伐破坏了许多动物的栖息地。

clearance.en: Staff need security clearance to enter this part of the laboratory.
clearance.zh: 工作人员需要安全许可才能进入实验室的这一区域。

outset.en: It was clear from the outset that the project would be expensive.
outset.zh: 从一开始就很清楚,这个项目花费会很高。

precaution.en: Hospitals take every precaution to prevent infections from spreading between patients.
precaution.zh: 医院采取一切预防措施,防止感染在病人之间传播。

disposition.en: Children with a calm disposition tend to adapt more easily to new schools.
disposition.zh: 性情平和的孩子往往更容易适应新学校。

gratitude.en: Studies suggest that expressing gratitude can improve people's sense of well-being.
gratitude.zh: 研究表明,表达感激可以提升人们的幸福感。

allegiance.en: Local rulers were forced to swear allegiance to the new king.
allegiance.zh: 地方统治者被迫宣誓效忠新国王。

proximity.en: Many early towns grew up because of their proximity to rivers.
proximity.zh: 许多早期城镇因靠近河流而发展起来。

inclination.en: Few young people have the time or the inclination to learn these old crafts.
inclination.zh: 很少有年轻人有时间或意愿学习这些传统手艺。

plight.en: The article drew attention to the plight of workers in the textile industry.
plight.zh: 这篇文章使人们开始关注纺织业工人的困境。

setback.en: The failure of the rocket was a major setback for the space programme.
setback.zh: 火箭发射失败是太空计划的一次重大挫折。

impetus.en: The oil crisis gave new impetus to research on solar energy.
impetus.zh: 石油危机为太阳能研究提供了新的推动力。

contingency.en: Governments need a contingency plan in case the water supply fails.
contingency.zh: 政府需要制定应急预案,以防供水中断。

myriad.en: The coral reef is home to a myriad of colourful fish.
myriad.zh: 珊瑚礁是无数色彩斑斓的鱼类的家园。

myriad.en: The internet offers myriad ways of learning a new language.
myriad.zh: 互联网提供了无数种学习新语言的方法。

conjunction.en: The drug works best when used in conjunction with regular exercise.
conjunction.zh: 这种药与规律运动结合使用时效果最好。

vicinity.en: Several ancient tombs have been found in the vicinity of the village.
vicinity.zh: 在这个村庄附近发现了几座古墓。

peril.en: Sailors of that period faced great peril on every long voyage.
peril.zh: 那个时期的水手每次远航都面临巨大的危险。

ordeal.en: The explorers described their long journey across the ice as a terrible ordeal.
ordeal.zh: 探险家们把穿越冰原的漫长旅程形容为一场可怕的磨难。

brink.en: Hunting had pushed the species to the brink of extinction by 1900.
brink.zh: 到 1900 年,狩猎已把这一物种逼到了灭绝的边缘。

purity.en: The purity of the water is tested every day at the treatment plant.
purity.zh: 水处理厂每天检测水的纯净度。
